full_name: Low Vision Quality of Life questionnaire (Wolffsohn and Cochrane 2000)
domains: mobility, distance vision and lighting; adjustment; reading and fine work; activities of daily living
scoring: summed score 0 (low quality of life) to 125 (high); subscale scores for distance mobility and lighting, and near and fine work
target_population: visually impaired patients in a clinical setting
notes: 25 items, 4 areas (p2); described as validated; 0-125 range (p1); this paper does not report its own validation; distance/mobility subscale mean 32.80 and near/fine work 10.48 at baseline (Table 2 p3)
